title: forge send data
description: Payload of `forge send --json`: one event dispatched to an agent. The handler's `say` lines are in `output`, never on stdout, and the envelope's `cost` is the dispatch's measured LLM spend — `0.0` when the handler made no LLM call.

file.description: Program file the agent was declared in.

agent.description: Agent the event was dispatched to.

event.description: Event name as given on the command line.

result.description: The handler's return value, or `null` when it returned nothing. A failed dispatch also reports `null`, with `error.type` `runtime`.

output.description: Every `say` line the handler printed, in order.
